product_metadata.title: Amtoodopin Trippy Planet Tapestry Magic Plants Tapestry Psychedelic Mountain Trees Tapestry Fantasy Universe Galaxy Wetlands Landscape Tapestry Wall Hanging for Bedroom W59×H51
features: Material: The Trippy Planet Tapestry is well crafted with lightweight polyester fabric, very soft and comfortable, perfect for hanging. The color does not fade after a long time of use, Give your space a new feeling and style.
Size: M-- W59.1"× H51.2"; L-- W78.7"× H59.1"; XL-- W92.5"× H70.8". Please choose the suitable size for different using.

Unique Design: How beautiful this Trippy Planet Tapestry is! Planet Tapestry is composed of a variety of amazing elements, mysterious starry sky, psychedelic magic plants, fascinating planets, outlines a full of fantasy universe world.

Versatile Usage: This Trippy Planet Tapestry is widely used as a wall hanging for wall, ceiling, ins background decor, it also can be used as bedspread, bedcover, table cloth, beach towel, shawl and so on.
Wash Guide: The Trippy Planet Tapestry should be washed by hand or machine in cold water. Dry in cool ventilated place. Don’t bleach and hot iron.
